set-variable.name: usageModel

metadata.name: RequestId
metadata.value: @{ var v = context.RequestId.ToString(); return v == null || v.Length == 0 ? "-" : v; }

metadata.name: CallerType
metadata.value: @{ var v = context.Subscription == null ? (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callerType", "") : "key"; return v == null || v.Length == 0 ? "-" : v; }

metadata.name: CallerId
metadata.value: @{ var v = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("usageId", ""); return v == null || v.Length == 0 ? "-" : v; }

metadata.name: CallerName
metadata.value: @{ var v = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("usageName", ""); return v == null || v.Length == 0 ? "-" : v; }

metadata.name: Client
metadata.value: @{ var v = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callerClient", ""); return v == null || v.Length == 0 ? "-" : v; }

metadata.name: AgentClient
metadata.value: @{ var v = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("agentClient", ""); return v == null || v.Length == 0 ? "-" : v; }

metadata.name: Api
metadata.value: @{ var v = context.Api.Name; return v == null || v.Length == 0 ? "-" : v; }

metadata.name: Product
metadata.value: @{ var v = context.Product == null ? null : context.Product.Id; return v == null || v.Length == 0 ? "-" : v; }

metadata.name: Model
metadata.value: @{ var v = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("usageModel", ""); return v == null || v.Length == 0 ? "-" : v; }
